metadata.issue_date_rule: last day of the fold's test block
metadata.availability_contract: only observations dated on or before the issue date are used; no future observed AOD or MERRA-2 is ever consulted
metadata.comparability_note: Each horizon forecasts a DIFFERENT target date from the same issue date, so cross-horizon MAE differences partly reflect target-date difficulty rather than horizon difficulty. The within-issue-date comparison in within_issue.csv isolates the horizon effect.
